system.notes: Force of Will is a basic offensive spell that most every Legionnaire who is capable learns. By focusing their will, the Legionnaire is capable of firing off a blast of electrical energy at a target within 20 meters. For most, this blast comes from an outstretched hand, but some in the Legion have been known to fire blasts from Dynamistic-glowing eyes. The blast does 5 DR to a single target within range.
